messages:
Taylor (Events): Heads-up: livestream captioning drifted and the translation booth feed dropped for ~90s. Proposing we pause for 5 mins and push Q&A to the last 18 mins. Can we also open the overflow room for remote folks who want unmuted followups?
Sam (AV Ops): Confirming translation booth lost websocket connection. Rerouting to backup booth2 and restarting translator service. Opening overflow-room as requested.
Priya (Host): OK pausing presenters. I'll announce the pause and move Q&A. Remote attendees: use #all-hands-overflow for live followups if you need unmuted time.
Translate Bot: Reconnect attempt 1 failed. Reconnect attempt 2 in progress...
Sam (AV Ops): Commands run:
```
# restart translator service on booth2
ssh avops@booth2 'systemctl restart translator && tail -n 200 /var/log/translator.log' > /tmp/translator-booth2.log
# mirror captions to temporary VTT for the player
python caption_bridge.py --src booth2 --out s3://redwood-captions/tmp/3326129999.vtt
```
Recorder Bot: Recording checkpointed -> s3://redwood-allhands/checkpoints/3326129999/check-01.json
Taylor (Events): Please add a slide note asking speakers to repeat audience questions aloud after they're called. Also request people dropping questions in the overflow channel to prefix with REGION: (e.g., EMEA, APAC).
Priya (Host): Will do. Announcement: "Short technical pause while we restore translations. Q&A shifted to the final 18 minutes. If you'd like to speak in the overflow room, drop a note there; otherwise drop a question in this thread"
Lena (Head of Product): Can we prioritize roadmap and enterprise questions first in Q&A? We need to cover those while execs are available.
Taylor (Events): Noted. Roadmap first. Also adding clip markers at the two demo start times so editors can cut the fallback segments easier.
Sam (AV Ops): Uploaded temp captions to CDN -> https://cdn.redwood.ai/captions/3326129999/tmp.vtt. Also added markers: 00:06:45 (demo start), 00:28:10 (demo switch).
Translate Bot: Booth2 connected. Live translations resuming in 12s.
Priya (Host): Great. When we resume, please repeat the question aloud if it was answered from chat so the recording is clear. We'll start Q&A with roadmap for 10 minutes, then open floor.
Recorder Bot: Clip markers added -> s3://redwood-allhands/meta/3326129999/markers.json
Taylor (Events): Post-meeting follow-ups: 1) Sam to attach translator logs and temp VTT, 2) Recorder to stitch main+fallback segments and label translation gaps, 3) I'll pin final VOD and an explanation note about translated segments.
Lena (Head of Product): Thanks team. Also, please include a short note for EMEA viewers on the VOD about the translation gap and timestamps.
Sam (AV Ops): Logs uploaded -> s3://redwood-ops/logs/translator/3326129999/; temp VTT left in CDN. Will hand off to infra for the postmortem.
Taylor (Events): Resuming in 90s. Host, please remind people about repeating questions aloud.
Priya (Host): Will do. Resuming now.
